request:
Among the production database connector classes that directly subclass SQLDatabase (auto_ontology/connectors/base.py), excluding classes in test code (any file under a tests/ folder), which ones override get_columns with their own get_columns method that has no docstring of its own (a leading # comment is not a docstring)? explanation: Finds production classes that directly subclass SQLDatabase, then locates their own get_columns method symbols. It filters to methods whose summary (docstring) is empty and excludes any file under a tests/ folder.
